description.value: The Station Pub is a neighbourhood pub in Invermere, BC, situated in the Columbia Valley — one of British Columbia's premier cycling corridors. It operates a full kitchen and a patio, making it a natural stop for cyclists passing through town. The pub explicitly does not take reservations, keeping the experience casual and drop-in friendly.
